response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS st, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS cnt FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT st, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: The average count, average share, and average excess are all taken over only the statuses that pass the filter (share above the average share across all statuses). The average share used as the threshold is computed over all statuses, including the NULL group.
A missing status means healtheval IS NULL. It is grouped as its own group, and empty strings are not treated specially.
An inner join drops conservation records whose zoneref has no matching site.
